na.ja: FDAがGRAS通知の義務化を提案 ─ 1958年以来の抜け穴を封鎖
na.en: FDA moves to make GRAS notification mandatory
na.ja_body: FDAは8月10日、添加物の安全性自己認定（GRAS）を見直す規則案を公表し11日に連邦官報へ掲載した。任意だった通知が義務化され、企業が通知なしに使用を始められた1958年以来の運用が転換する。意見公募は12月9日まで。
na.en_body: On August 10 the FDA proposed a rule overhauling GRAS self-affirmation, published in the Federal Register on August 11. It makes notification mandatory rather than voluntary, ending a route that since 1958 let manufacturers add substances without telling regulators. Comments close December 9.

na.ja: 超加工食品の連邦定義がOMBへ ─ ただし「白書」で拘束力なし
na.en: UPF definition reaches OMB — but as a white paper, not a binding rule
na.ja_body: HHS・FDA・USDAは8月3日、連邦政府として初の超加工食品（UPF）定義案をOIRAへ提出した。規則案ではなく白書のため拘束力はないが、今後の前面表示（FOP）ルールや再配合の基準に影響するとみられる。
na.en_body: HHS, FDA and USDA sent the first federal definition of ultra-processed foods to OIRA on August 3. Filed as a white paper rather than a proposed rule, it carries no binding labeling or reformulation requirement, yet it is expected to shape the coming front-of-pack rule and reformulation timelines.

na.en: July food CPI +3.0%: beef up 9.4%, eggs down 25.7%
na.ja_body: 労働統計局の7月CPIは食品全体+3.0%、家庭内食+2.7%。牛肉・子牛肉が+9.4%と突出し、生体牛価格は26年通年で+11.6%の見込み。卵は鳥インフル後の群回復で前年比-25.7%まで下落した。
na.en_body: BLS July data put all-food CPI at +3.0% year on year and food-at-home at +2.7%. Beef and veal stand out at +9.4%, with farm-level cattle prices forecast up 11.6% for 2026. Eggs are down 25.7% annually as flocks recover from avian influenza.

na.ja: クラフトハインツが通期見通しを上方修正 ─ 投資は7億ドルへ増額
na.en: Kraft Heinz lifts full-year guidance, raising investment to $700M
na.ja_body: クラフトハインツの4-6月期は調整後EPS0.56ドルと予想0.53ドルを上回った。通期オーガニック売上見通しを-1.5〜-3.5%から-0.5〜-2.0%へ改善し、販促・イノベーション投資を1億ドル増の約7億ドルへ引き上げる。
na.en_body: Kraft Heinz beat on August 5 with adjusted EPS of $0.56 against a $0.53 consensus. It narrowed the full-year organic sales outlook to a 0.5–2.0% decline from 1.5–3.5%, and is adding $100M to lift marketing and innovation spend to about $700M.

na.ja: アジア系食品が「エスニック棚」を卒業 ─ 成長は全体の約4倍
na.en: Asian food graduates from the ethnic aisle, growing about 4x the category
na.ja_body: 米国のアジア系包装食品は包装食品全体の約4倍の速さで伸びている。醤油や即席麺に限られた売場は日韓タイ中印の専用セクションへ拡大。塩系スナックの伸長味ではマサラと韓国BBQが上位5位に入る。
na.en_body: Retail sales of Asian packaged foods in the US are growing roughly four times faster than packaged food overall. Aisles once limited to soy sauce and instant ramen are now dedicated sections spanning Japanese, Korean, Thai, Chinese and Indian goods. Masala and Korean BBQ rank top-five among fastest-growing salty snack flavors.

jp.ja: コメに高温障害 ─ 早期収穫進むも「新米の方が安くなる」懸念
jp.en: Heat damage hits the rice crop as early harvest begins
jp.ja_body: 記録的猛暑を受け、三重県木曽岬町では8月10日過ぎに例年より早くコメの収穫が始まった。7月の高温障害で一等米比率の低下が懸念される。倉庫には古米が積み上がり、産地からは「新米の方が値段が下がる可能性がある」との声も出ている。
jp.en_body: After a record heatwave, rice harvesting began just after August 10 in Kisosaki, Mie Prefecture, earlier than usual. July's extreme heat has raised concern over quality damage and a lower share of top-grade grain. With warehouses still holding carryover stock, growers warn the new crop could fetch lower prices than the old.
jp.src: 出典：中京テレビ／livedoorニュース

jp.ja: 8月値上げ2,311品目、加工食品は前年の約7倍 ─ 9月は4,531品目
jp.en: 2,311 items repriced in August; September brings 4,531
jp.ja_body: 帝国データバンクによると8月の飲食料品値上げは2,311品目で前年比8割増。最多は加工食品1,419品目（前年188品目の約7倍）、次いで調味料589、原材料276。森永乳業は8月1日出荷分から47品を3.1〜11.4%改定。9月は4,531品目と約3年ぶりの規模になる。
jp.en_body: Teikoku Databank counts 2,311 food and drink items repriced in August, up about 80% year on year. Processed foods lead at 1,419 items, some seven times last year's 188, followed by seasonings at 589 and raw materials at 276. Morinaga Milk revised 47 items by 3.1–11.4% from August 1 shipments. September brings 4,531 items, the most in roughly three years.
jp.src: 出典：帝国データバンク／マイナビニュース／森永乳業

jp.ja: コンビニは「雰囲気を楽しむ」路線へ ─ 8月は濃厚チョコと映画コラボ
jp.en: Convenience stores lean into mood: rich chocolate and film tie-ins
jp.ja_body: 日本食糧新聞は8月のテーマに、代替ではなく「○○風」で雰囲気を楽しむ食品と拡大するコラボ商戦を挙げた。真夏に濃厚チョコを投じるローソン、映画コラボのファミマ、スパイス系のセブンと差別化が進む。レモンもこ（216円・8月11日）など和素材スイーツも定番化した。
jp.en_body: Nihon Shokuryo Shimbun names two August themes: foods that evoke a style rather than substitute for it, and a widening wave of collaborations. Lawson is pushing rich Premium Chocolat into midsummer, FamilyMart is running film tie-ins and Seven-Eleven is going spice-forward. Japanese-ingredient sweets such as Lemon Moko (¥216, August 11) are now fixtures.
jp.src: 出典：日本食糧新聞／トクバイニュース

kr.ja: 農心の4-6月営業益+47.6% ─ 米国・中国が国内の停滞を補う
kr.en: Nongshim Q2 operating profit +47.6% as the US and China offset home
kr.ja_body: 農心の4-6月期連結売上高は前年同期比10.2%増の9,561億ウォン（約6.9億ドル）、営業利益は47.6%増の593億ウォン。米国と中国の海外売上が伸びを主導し、国内は横ばい圏。釜山の輸出専用工場が26年に稼働し、供給制約の解消が次の焦点となる。
kr.en_body: Nongshim posted Q2 consolidated revenue of KRW 956.1B (about $690M), up 10.2%, with operating profit up 47.6% to KRW 59.3B. Overseas sales in the US and China drove the gain while domestic growth stayed muted. A new export-only plant in Busan starts up in 2026, making supply relief the next thing to watch.

kr.ja: CJ第一製糖は増収減益 ─ 海外食品+10.1%も原料高が利益を圧迫
kr.en: CJ CheilJedang grows sales but profit falls on input costs
kr.ja_body: CJ第一製糖の4-6月期（8月11日発表）は連結売上高が10.2%増の4兆1,950億ウォン、営業利益は18.4%減の1,619億ウォン。食品部門は5.8%増、うち海外食品が10.1%増の1兆5,072億ウォンと伸びをけん引。為替・デリバティブ評価損で239億ウォンの純損失を計上した。
kr.en_body: CJ CheilJedang reported Q2 sales on August 11 of KRW 4,195B, up 10.2%, with operating profit down 18.4% to KRW 161.9B. The food division rose 5.8%, led by overseas food up 10.1% to KRW 1,507.2B. Non-operating items including FX and derivative valuation losses produced a net loss of KRW 23.9B.

cn.ja: 即時小売はインフラ競争へ ─ 阿里は「淘宝便利店」3,000店を計画
cn.en: Instant retail shifts to infrastructure; Alibaba plans 3,000 stores
cn.ja_body: 競争軸が補助金合戦から物流・店舗網の構築へ移った。阿里巴巴は年末までに「淘宝便利店」3,000店を展開し、菓子・飲料を含む1万SKUを扱う計画。美団は30分配送の「美団閃購」、京東は「JD NOW」で対抗する。市場は2029年に1,267億ドルへ拡大する見通し。
cn.en_body: Competition has moved from subsidy wars to building logistics and store networks. Alibaba plans 3,000 Taobao Convenience Stores by year-end carrying 10,000 SKUs including snacks and beverages. Meituan counters with 30-minute Meituan Shangou and JD with JD NOW. The market is projected to reach $126.7B by 2029, with sub-60-minute delivery the tier-one standard.
cn.src: 出典：China Digital Retail／Yahoo Finance／業界報道

cn.ja: 機能性が主戦場に ─ 炭酸新商品の29%が健康訴求
cn.en: Function becomes the battleground: 29% of new carbonates carry a health claim
cn.ja_body: プレバイオティクスやビタミン、食物繊維を含む機能性飲料が「健康的な間食」として定着し、炭酸新商品の29%が健康訴求を持つ。飲料の機能性パーソナライズは12%成長。高齢化でヘルシーエイジング需要も拡大し、健康・鮮度・食感に加え味と価格が購買を左右する。
cn.en_body: Functional drinks with prebiotics, vitamins or fiber have settled in as a healthier snacking option, and 29% of new carbonated launches now carry at least one health claim. Functional personalization in beverages is growing 12%. Aging is lifting healthy-aging demand, while health, freshness and texture sit alongside flavor and price as purchase drivers.
